features.notes: Works on happy path. Unreadable state is overwritten by fresh state and lost after one edit (ST-01). The backup copy doubles storage use, and a failed backup write shows a false save error (ST-10). Nothing handles multiple tabs (ST-19).

features.name: Boot load + normalize
features.notes: escobar and units blocks are repaired well. The top-level normalize does not validate enums or array elements (ST-11).

features.notes: Idempotent (runs only when no saved or backup key exists). lb users get a kg gym (ST-09). Date-only strings shift a day (ST-18). Fuzzy name mapping (ST-13) and the muscle classifier (ST-12) mis-attribute data.

features.name: Backup restore
features.notes: Checks only version and sessions. HR series are never included in backups (ST-21).

features.name: Service worker / offline PWA
features.notes: Cache-first index plus deleting old caches plus caching 404s leaves users on a stale build and makes lazy chunks fail (ST-03). Assets are not precached, so offline fails after only one visit (ST-04). Not used in the Capacitor APK.

features.name: Crash handler
features.notes: Fires for any error after boot and offers a destructive reset while saying the data is untouched (ST-02).

features.name: Theme engine
features.notes: Switching works. Tokens exist only after JS runs, so the first paint is unthemed (ST-20).

features.name: Router / App shell / panels
features.notes: The muscle panel param is not validated (ST-14). The lazy Escobar import has no catch (ST-15).

features.name: Clock & derived selectors
features.notes: Recovery and insight 'now' freeze whenever no session or rest is ticking (ST-05). The ticker is not ref-counted (ST-06). recoveryStatus runs every second during a session (ST-07).

features.name: Dates
features.notes: DST-safe. The cache goes stale after a timezone change (ST-08). dayKey mis-parses YYYY-MM-DD strings (ST-18).

features.name: Units kg/lb
features.notes: Typed values round-trip exactly through entered. lb display rounding hides 0.25-lb steps (ST-24).

features.name: Exercise library lookup/search
features.notes: Exact name/alias lookup is correct for all 123 exercises. The fuzzy substring fallback maps generic names wrongly (ST-13).

features.name: Heart series store
features.notes: Store and LRU work. Series are not deleted with their session, not included in backups, and reads are not shape-validated (ST-21).

features.name: Static data integrity (exercises, templates, goals, knowledge)
features.notes: Validated by script: 0 issues.

features.name: Coach cues data
features.notes: 27 of 422 cues can never be selected (ST-17).

improvements.title: Quarantine unreadable state, validate deeply in normalize, and add a store test suite
improvements.rationale: Nothing tests store.ts (no test imports initStore/persistNow). ST-01, ST-10, ST-11 and ST-19 are silent-loss paths.

improvements.title: Make the crash handler non-destructive after boot and add an export-first reset
improvements.rationale: ST-02: any error after boot currently offers a full wipe while saying the data is untouched.

improvements.title: Rewrite the service worker: network-first navigations, cache only OK responses, precache the asset list, prompt for update
improvements.rationale: ST-03/ST-04: stale builds, cached 404s and offline blank screens for PWA users.

improvements.title: Single clock module: minuteNow signal, ref-counted ticker, visibility refresh, timezone-change reset
improvements.rationale: ST-05/06/07/08/16 all come from the ad-hoc clock in selectors.ts plus pageshow. One refresh path fixes stale recovery, the frozen rest banner, per-second recompute and timezone drift.

improvements.title: Move bulk data off localStorage (IndexedDB or Capacitor Filesystem) or at least drop the per-save full backup for a daily snapshot
improvements.rationale: State + a full backup copy + 60 HR series + Escobar conversations share the ~5 MB origin quota. At roughly 2-3 KB per session, heavy users reach quota within a few years, then every save fails.

improvements.title: Add a schemaRev field and an ordered migration runner
improvements.rationale: The version is fixed at 1. Schema evolution relies on additive spreads in normalize, and field renames or semantic changes (e.g. units per gym) have no hook. Legacy lb import (ST-09) shows how easily fresh defaults leak in.

improvements.title: Wire reason-* coach cues to progression reasons and fix/remove unreachable cues
improvements.rationale: ST-17: 15 authored 'why this suggestion' explanations are never shown. They would make suggestNext's decisions visible to the user.

improvements.title: Include HR series in backup/restore and delete with the session
improvements.rationale: ST-21: series are lost on device migration and orphaned on delete.

improvements.title: Show 'Recovered from backup' when bootSource is 'backup'
improvements.rationale: Boot from backup currently shows only 'Loaded from: backup' deep in Settings, so the user never learns that the latest edits may be missing.

improvements.title: Strict id lookup for tool arguments; unique-only fuzzy name matching
improvements.rationale: ST-13: fuzzy substring matching mis-maps generic names in migration and in Escobar tool validation.

improvements.title: Static first-paint theme CSS in index.html
improvements.rationale: ST-20: unthemed flash before the bundle executes.

improvements.title: Remove dead exports and deduplicate damage constants; single-source app version
improvements.files: src/core/store.ts, src/core/dates.ts, src/core/exercises.ts, src/data/recovery.ts, vite.config.ts, src/slices/settings/Settings.tsx, scripts/convert-legacy-backup.ts, tsconfig.json

improvements.title: User-selectable week start (Mon/Sun)
improvements.rationale: weekStart is hard-coded to Monday, while weekly review keys, week summaries and volume weeks all use it. US users see weeks split differently from their calendar.

improvements.title: Use newId('custom') in makeCustomExercise and unify the custom pattern ('other' vs Escobar's 'custom')
improvements.rationale: `custom_${Date.now().toString(36)}` can collide within one ms. escobar/apply.ts uses pattern 'custom' while makeCustomExercise uses 'other', so pattern-based cues and rules treat them differently.

improvements.title: Run Watch plugin work on the main thread and throttle device events
improvements.rationale: Removes CME crash risk and bridge flooding (PL-08, PL-13).

improvements.title: Exact-alarm check/request flow for rest timer
improvements.rationale: Rest-done alert timing is a core live-session feature; exact alarms are denied by default on Android 14+ (PL-09).

improvements.title: Accurate Health Connect privacy rationale
improvements.rationale: Play review and user trust; current text contradicts Escobar data sharing (PL-10).

improvements.title: Deploy Worker from main after a green gate, pin wrangler
improvements.rationale: Current trigger points at a feature branch and ignores the app-side tools-sync test (PL-11).

improvements.title: Deduplicate the Android project generation between gate and release workflows
improvements.rationale: The 'Generate/Configure Android project' and verification blocks are copy-pasted in build-apk.yml:82-146 and release-apk.yml:87-165 and have already drifted (icon background #08090A vs #06131B). Move into scripts/prepare-android.sh (minSdk patch, cap sync, copy native/*.java, patch_manifest.py, icons, greps) called by both.

improvements.title: Proper adaptive launcher icon
improvements.rationale: Both workflows copy the 512 px full icon as ic_launcher_foreground into every density; adaptive masks crop it and APK carries 15 copies. Render a 432 px foreground with the mark inside the 66% safe zone via scripts/render-logo.mjs and copy per density.

improvements.title: Reuse the gated web build in android-gate
improvements.rationale: android-gate re-runs npm ci + npm run build instead of downloading the MARC-www artifact, so the APK is not byte-proven to be the gated build and CI time doubles.

improvements.title: Validator/size hardening and remove unused client cache_control
improvements.rationale: PL-12, PL-14: cheap input hardening.

improvements.title: Remove or wire dead native diagnostics; delete worker MODE_ADDENDUM
